subject: The 3AM bet that won 1,200 credits
preview_text: One user's late-night hunch turned into a 1,200-credit win. Their story made our team stop. Read it inside.
body_paragraphs: Last Tuesday, 3:14 AM. A user named Marco logged in, checked our AI's 73% confidence call on a random Serie B match, and placed a small bet. He woke up to 1,200 credits in his account. His message to support: 'I finally stopped guessing. The data was right.'

Marco had been losing bets for months, relying on gut feelings and Twitter tipsters. Then he started using our AI predictions—analyzing xG, defensive stats, and head-to-head history for every match. He told us: 'It's like having a stats coach in your pocket. I don't even look at other tips now.'

That's the power of our AI Chat feature. Ask it any question—'Who wins the midfield battle in this derby?'—and get instant data-backed answers. Confidence scores tell you exactly how sure the AI is. No guesswork.
Open Predictify now, go to AI Chat, and type: 'What's my best bet today?' See what the data says. P.S. Marco's streak is at 14 days. Yours is waiting.
